description: This risk arises when an agent retrieves or processes content from malicious or untrusted websites that are designed to inject instructions or manipulative prompts into the system. As a result, the agent may follow unintended commands, override intended constraints, or take actions that compromise system behaviour or integrity.

controls.statement: Implement input guardrails to detect prompt injection and adversarial attacks
Implement escape filtering before incorporating web content into prompts
Use structured retrieval APIs for web searches rather than web scraping
Enforce data-flow and capability policies at runtime with a deterministic policy layer that separates untrusted content from privileged actions
